content.text: It’s a popular choice for international students, but is USC worth it for you? 🤔 For those who are new here: I did my MS for free in UIUC and dropped out of MBA at NYU. I have worked on Wall Street and been mentoring study abroad aspirants in India, Asia, Middle East and US for more than a decade. Doing this for fun and positive energy 🤩 Today I want to analyze whether USC is worth the investment or not 👇 📌 Strengths: 1️⃣ Strong Reputation: Ranked #20 for CS by US News & consistently in the top tier of engineering schools globally. 2️⃣ Job Outcomes: LA offers access to big tech companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, and industries like entertainment tech and gaming. Starting salaries for graduates range from $100–$130K/year. 3️⃣ Research Opportunities: Known for strengths in AI, robotics, data science, and cybersecurity, USC has an annual research expenditure exceeding $900M across disciplines. 4️⃣ Living in LA: Access to diverse cultures, great weather, and countless networking events—perfect for extroverts and tech enthusiasts! 📌 Weaknesses: - Class Size: They take a lot of students and everybody is competing for everything! This causes a lot of stress. - Jobs: I know at least 3 students who haven’t found jobs after graduating from USC. Its such a big class size that everyone is just not going to find internships and jobs. - High Cost: Tuition is approximately $38K/year, and living costs in LA average $25–$30K/year—among the highest in the US. 📌 Verdict: I don’t think USC is giving the ROI esp in current job market and you should think twice before applying. Tag a friend who’s considering studying in the US.
